title: Sales And Marketing Associate
description:
**Company Description**
SMD REAL ESTATE JOKA is a growing real estate organization focused on residential and commercial property solutions in and around Thakurpukur. The company works closely with clients to understand their needs and provide suitable property options, emphasizing transparency and reliability in all transactions. Team members collaborate across sales and marketing functions to build strong client relationships and drive sustainable business growth. The work environment values professionalism, ethical conduct, and long-term customer satisfaction.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site role for a Sales and Marketing Associate based in Thakurpukur. The role involves identifying and engaging potential buyers and tenants, conducting property visits, and explaining property features, pricing, and terms. The associate will handle client inquiries, maintain regular follow-up, and provide customer support throughout the sales process. Daily responsibilities include implementing sales and marketing campaigns, distributing promotional materials, coordinating local outreach activities, and updating basic records of leads and conversions. The role also requires collaborating with senior team members, participating in product and sales training, and supporting overall business development efforts.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong Communication skills, including clear verbal and written interaction with clients and team members.
* Customer Service skills to manage inquiries, build rapport, and ensure a positive client experience.
* Sales and Sales & Marketing skills to generate leads, convert prospects, and support promotional activities.
* Ability to learn quickly and participate in Training related to products, sales processes, and compliance.
* Basic understanding of real estate or willingness to learn; prior experience in sales or field marketing is an advantage.
* Comfort with on-site client meetings in Thakurpukur and nearby areas; ability to work flexible hours when needed.
* Proficiency in local language and English for client communication; basic computer skills for maintaining records.
* Minimum high school education; higher education in business, marketing, or a related field is preferred but not mandatory.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
**Company Description** 
 Edu World Skill Academy is an education and training organization focused on developing practical skills for learners across diverse disciplines. The academy aims to enhance employability by offering structured programs that align with industry needs and emerging career paths. It promotes an inclusive learning environment where participants can gain both theoretical knowledge and hands\-on experience. Team members at Edu World Skill Academy contribute directly to improving access to quality skill\-based education and supporting learner success.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Marketing Executive role based in North 24 Parganas. The Marketing Executive will support the promotion of the academy’s programs by planning and executing marketing campaigns, both offline and online. Day\-to\-day tasks include conducting market research to understand target audiences, assisting in market planning, coordinating with the sales team, and developing communication materials such as brochures, social media posts, and email content. The role involves engaging with prospective learners, educational partners, and local institutions to build brand awareness and drive admissions. The Marketing Executive will also track campaign performance, prepare reports, and collaborate with internal teams to ensure consistent messaging and effective outreach.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Ability to perform market planning and market research, including analyzing trends and identifying target segments.
* Strong communication skills, with the capacity to create clear, engaging messaging for diverse audiences.
* Demonstrated experience or interest in sales and marketing activities, particularly within the education or training sector.
* Comfort using basic digital tools for marketing and data tracking (e.g., spreadsheets, presentation tools, social media platforms).
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field is preferred.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
* Capacity to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams and interact professionally with learners and partners.
* Local language proficiency and familiarity with the North 24 Parganas region will be an advantage.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
Key Responsibilities:
   

  

 \- Plan and execute digital marketing campaigns across social media and other online platforms.
   

 \- Manage and grow social media channels with engaging content.
   

 \- Run and monitor Meta Ads, Google Ads, and other paid campaigns.
   

 \- Conduct basic keyword research, SEO, and competitor analysis.
   

 \- Generate leads and track campaign performance.
   

 \- Prepare performance reports and analyze marketing metrics.
   

 \- Coordinate with the creative/content team for marketing campaigns.
   

 \- Stay updated with the latest digital marketing trends and tools.
   

 \- If required, conduct digital marketing classes/training sessions for students.
   

  

 Requirement:
   

  

 \- 1 to 2 years of experience in Digital Marketing.
   

 \- Good knowledge of Social Media Marketing, Meta Ads, Google Ads, SEO \& Lead Generation.
   

 \- Strong communication and presentation skills.
   

 \- Ability to analyze campaign performance and make improvements.
   

 \- Good understanding of social media trends and content strategies.
   

 \- Teaching, mentoring, or training experience will be an added advantage.
   

  

  

 What We Offer
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with live projects.
   

 Opportunity to work on real client campaigns.
   

 Learning and career growth opportunities.
   

 Supportive and professional work environment.
